item.title: NIH asks if Fauci secretly wrote paper that dismissed Covid lab leak theory
item.description: Lab leak proponents believe Anthony Fauci commissioned the Nature Medicine study to cover up U.S. funding of Chinese virology research.

media:content.media:title: The dispute over the article has become a proxy for broader fights over whether the pandemic originated in a lab in Wuhan, China and whether U.S. officials exerted undue influence to stamp out debate.

item.title: White House pulls FDA pick over lack of support
item.description: The Senate Health, Education, Labor and Pensions Committee was scheduled to vote Wednesday morning on White House policy aide Heidi Overton to lead the FDA

item.title: Democrats blame RFK Jr. after US loses measles-elimination status
item.description: An arm of the World Health Organization found that measles is endemic in America for the first time in 26 years.

media:content.media:title: “Trump, Vance and Republicans empowered Robert Kennedy and his deputies to run America’s public health into the ground, and they have blood on their hands,” Sen. Ron Wyden (D-Ore.) said in a statement.

item.title: Georgia, Kansas and Texas eye Medicaid expansion after midterms romp
item.description: The Trump admin made expansion harder and more expensive. The states Democrats flipped are trying anyway.

media:content.media:title: Texas Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa is one of several Democrats who campaigned on expanding Medicaid in some of the nation's few remaining holdout states. (Photo by RONALDO SCHEMIDT / AFP via Getty Images)

item.title: New Medicaid work requirements delayed
item.description: The delay is optional for states, some of which have complained to the agency that they are unprepared to go fully live in January

media:content.media:title: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services Administrator Mehmet Oz announced an optional grace period Friday for states struggling to set up their Medicaid work requirement system by the January deadline.
